data.paraphrase: For every natural number n, and for all n×n matrices A, B, and M over the real numbers, if n is greater than 0, and if A multiplied by M equals M multiplied by B, and if the characteristic polynomial of A equals the characteristic polynomial of B, then for any n×n matrix X, the determinant of (A minus M multiplied by X) equals the determinant of (B minus X multiplied by M).
